blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Federal Express Corp. (FedEx) has expanded its trans-Pacific air freight network ahead of the year-end shipping season, adding 567,000 kilograms of weekly capacity between the Asia-Pacific region and the United States. The expanded air operations connect key manufacturing and export markets—including the Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Hong Kong, China and Japan—with major […]...
